text: Quality tooling is configured in `pyproject.toml`: pytest uses `testpaths = ["tests"]` and `addopts = "-q"`; Ruff uses `target-version = "py311"`, `line-length = 120`, and excludes `[".venv", ".outcomegraph", "__pycache__"]`; Ty sets `environment.root = ["."]`, includes `og.py` and `tests/**/*.py`, excludes virtualenv and cache paths, and marks `possibly-unresolved-reference`, `invalid-return-type`, and `unused-type-ignore-comment` as `error` while several other Ty rules are `ignore`.
